title: Quietly Roasted Ethiopian Boudin Blanc Roast
description: A comforting and flavorful lacto-vegetarian dish featuring boudin blanc, perfect for a sick day, with a yeasty and crisp texture, inspired by Ethiopian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the berbere spice, salt, black pepper, and yeast.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the bowl and mix well.
Add the boudin blanc to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Transfer the mixture to a large Dutch oven or heavy pot with a lid.
Drizzle the vegetable oil over the top of the mixture.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast for 30 minutes, then remove the lid and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the torn injera bread.
Serve hot, garnished with additional injera bread if desired.
